text:
Table of corn varieties available in Cambodia and their reported characteristics (variety | kernel colour | breeding type | maturity class | days to flowering | days to harvest | plant height at maturity, m | yield potential, t/ha | downy mildew resistance):

- CP 888: yellow with grey tinge; hybrid; medium maturity; 50-55 days to flowering; 105-110 days to harvest; 1.8-2.1 m; 6.0-13.5 t/ha; resistant (R) to downy mildew.
- CP 999: yellow with grey tinge; hybrid; early/short maturity; 52 days to flowering; 60-65 days to harvest; 1.6-1.8 m; 6.0-13.5 t/ha; resistant (R).
- Leuang Mongkol: yellow; open-pollinated; medium maturity; 53-55 days to flowering; 100-106 days to harvest; 1.54-2.48 m; 4.2-10.6 t/ha; no downy mildew data available.
- Sovanh 5: yellow; open-pollinated; medium maturity; 53-57 days to flowering; 100-115 days to harvest; 1.87 m; 3.32 t/ha; resistant (R).
- CP AAA: yellow with grey tinge; hybrid; early/short maturity; 52 days to flowering; 60-65 days to harvest; 1.6-1.8 m; 6.0-13.5 t/ha; resistant (R).
- 30B80: yellow with grey tinge; hybrid; medium maturity; 60 days to flowering; 110 days to harvest; 2.45 m; 6.7 t/ha; no downy mildew data available.
- Samasathat: white; open-pollinated; early/short maturity; 40-48 days to flowering; 60-100 days to harvest; 1.75-1.95 m; 1.02-6.35 t/ha; no downy mildew data available.
- Sadai: white; open-pollinated; medium maturity; 53-55 days to flowering; 104-112 days to harvest; 1.56-2.36 m; 4.1-8.7 t/ha; no downy mildew data available.
- Poat Domnoeb: white; open-pollinated; early/short maturity; 60-64 days to flowering; printed as 80-60 days to harvest (likely a reversed/mistyped range in the source, reported as printed rather than corrected); 1.0 m; 0.7-2.40 t/ha; no downy mildew data available.

The source cautions that these figures should be treated only as a general indication of variety characteristics: they are based on limited Cambodia-specific data and can vary considerably with planting time, field conditions, and location. Note also that CP999's listed harvest window (60-65 days) is very close behind its flowering date (52 days), which is unusually short for dry grain corn and may indicate this entry is intended for a green/fresh-eating harvest rather than dry grain, though the source does not state this explicitly.
